label: VERIFIED
extraction: Agent Teams AI: TypeScript orchestration framework (1,740 stars, 303 forks) supporting 200+ models across 75+ LLM providers. Puts kanban board at center as single source of truth for task state. Coordination model: agents pull tasks from board (Backlog -> In Progress -> Review -> Done). Task ownership: agent claims task by writing lock with timestamp and agent ID; others see lock and skip. State transitions: only forward (Backlog -> In Progress -> Review -> Done); moving backward requires human approval or peer review rejection. Visibility: all agents see full board, no agent-specific queue or hidden state. Structured messaging between agents. Peer review: agents review each other's output. Avoids 'who does what' ambiguity and cascading failures. TypeScript framework exposes practical patterns for agent-to-agent communication most frameworks ignore.
